Juhye Park

Ph.D. Student
KAIST, Department of Electrical and Electronic Engineering
Advised by Prof. Hyun Myung

My research focuses on advancing Embodied AI within human-centric environments, enabling robots to intelligently execute complex tasks in diverse social settings. To achieve this, I explore various areas such as cross-view geo-localization and Vision-Language-Navigation.
